workloads.name: narrow-to-region
workloads.form:
;;; -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
(progn (require 'bytecomp)
(defvar m nil) (defvar ov nil) (defvar st nil) (defvar sample nil)
(defvar cell nil) (defvar km nil)
(require 'thingatpt)
(require 'syntax)
(setq gc-cons-threshold 100000000 gc-cons-percentage 1.0)
(setq sweep-global 17)
(put 'sweep 'probe 19)
(defun sweep-normalize (x)
 (cond ((markerp x) (marker-position x))
       ((bufferp x) (buffer-name x))
       ((overlayp x) (list (overlay-start x) (overlay-end x)))
       ((consp x) (cons (sweep-normalize (car x)) (sweep-normalize (cdr x))))
       (t x)))

(when (getenv "SWEEP_EXPECT_IMAGE")
 (let ((v (pdumper-stats)))
  (unless (and (cdr (assq 'dumped-with-pdumper v))
               (equal (cdr (assq 'dump-file-name v)) (getenv "SWEEP_EXPECT_IMAGE")))
    (error "REQUIRED SHIPPING IMAGE NOT LOADED: %S" v))
  (princ "IMAGE=") (prin1 v) (terpri)))
(with-current-buffer (get-buffer-create "*sweep*")
(let (m ov st sample) (erase-buffer)
(insert (apply #'concat (make-list 400 "(alpha beta gamma 123 λ)
")))
(put-text-property 50 120 'sweep 7)
(setq m (copy-marker 100) ov (make-overlay 200 250) st (syntax-table)
      sample "(alpha beta gamma 123 λ) abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz")
(overlay-put ov 'sweep 9)
(set-mark 20)
(goto-char 1)
(re-search-forward "alpha")
(goto-char 1)
 (setq cell (cons 1 2) km (make-sparse-keymap)) (set (quote sweep-input-0) 1)
(set (quote sweep-input-1) 5000)
(fset 'sweep-loop (let ((lexical-binding t)) (byte-compile '(lambda (n) (let ((i 0) (p 1) (s nil))
(while (< i n) (setq p (1+ (% i 4096))) (setq s (progn (narrow-to-region sweep-input-0 sweep-input-1) (widen))) (setq i (1+ i)))
(list s p i))))))
(unless (byte-code-function-p (symbol-function (quote sweep-loop))) (error "loop not bytecode"))
(let* ((answer (sweep-loop ITERATIONS_TOKEN))
       (answer (sweep-normalize answer)))
(princ "SWEEP=") (prin1 (list answer (point) (buffer-size))) (terpri)))))
